details: 1.0.75 Windows COM3 (same cable as the reporter's IC-910): one stray byte, then no echo and no reply to 1a/00 at 66h. A CI-V interface that does not echo is usually not on a powered bus (radio off or cable not seated) or the USB adapter needs replugging. Asked for setup checks.
summary: Read times out: no CI-V echo, no radio reply
